entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SocketsHttpHandler HTTP/2 pings are broken in multiple scenarios #120179
    11.0.0
  • NativeAOT: ILCompiler crash InvalidCastException in EnsureLoadableType when publishing NativeLib on .NET 9.0.305 #120178
  • [Analyzer Proposal]: Replace 'suppress exceptions for single `await`' pattern with `ConfigureAwaitOptions.SuppressThrowing` analyzer/fix #120177
  • [wasm/browser] Failed to connect to socket /run/dbus/system_bus_socket #120176
  • System.Exception : Timed out after 10s waiting for 'WASM EXIT' message #120174
  • Test failure: System.Formats.Cbor.Tests.CborPropertyTests.Roundtrip_Double #120173
  • Test failure: JIT/Regression/JitBlue/DevDiv_461649/DevDiv_461649/DevDiv_461649.cmd #120171
    11.0.0
  • Test failure: JIT/Regression/JitBlue/Runtime_72845/Runtime_72845/Runtime_72845.cmd #120170
    11.0.0

Closed

  • Suggestion: Prefer `ValueTask<T>(T)` constructor over `ValueTask<T>(Task<T>)` when `null` is passed #120156
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] .NET 10 RC2 X64 SDK can't been installed on Windows ARM64. #120108
    10.0.0
  • Test failure: DataContractSerializerTests.DCS_MyPersonSurrogate_Stress #120172
  • [wasm coreclr] unboxing stubs #120092
    Future

Created

  • WASM enable GC support #120175
    arch-wasm, area-VM-coreclr, 11.0.0

Merged

  • Fix unboxing stubs on wasm #120153
    arch-wasm, area-VM-coreclr, Future

Updated

  • Update [GeneratedRegex] analyzer/fixer for partial properties #120099
  • Add BFloat16 #98643
    area-System.Numerics, new-api-needs-documentation, community-contribution
  • [browser][coreCLR] TypeScript host skeleton #119866
    arch-wasm, area-Host, linkable-framework, os-browser, 11.0.0

    area-PAL-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Revert SA1129 suppression in `System.Speech` #119988
    NO-MERGE, area-System.Speech, community-contribution
  • Make case insensitive matches respect case insensitivity on the root. #120159
    area-Extensions-FileSystem, community-contribution
  • Optimize `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` throw helpers #119234
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
